scope: Phase 10E physical validation of public keyboard.press through the real runtime and SDK against an independent test-owned AppKit text oracle
platform: macOS Quartz/CoreGraphics + Carbon symbolic key identities + AppKit

publicContract.modifierLifecycle: POSTED or NOT_REQUIRED according to tuple

physicalOracle.type: AppKit NSTextView first responder in a separate process
physicalOracle.plainA: public a press must independently produce exactly one down/up pair and lowercase text consequence
physicalOracle.enter: public enter press must independently produce exactly one down/up pair and newline consequence
physicalOracle.shiftA: public shift+a press must independently produce exactly one Shift on/off transition, one shifted a down/up pair and uppercase text consequence

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The macOS/Swift/Accessibility environment prevents the product helper, runtime or independent fixture from compiling or executing.
resultPolicy.FAIL: The public contract, tuple restriction, independent key/modifier delivery, text consequence, cleanup, restoration, privacy or semantic-boundary invariant fails.
resultPolicy.PASS: The real public SDK path posts all three physically grounded keyboard tuples with the required delivery-only boundary while the independent AppKit oracle confirms exact delivery/consequence and clean modifier lifecycle.

nextStepOnPass: Promote keyboard.press to PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED without changing the validated runtime, record authoritative evidence, then close Phase 10 low-level fallback mechanics and keep OCR/vision as a separate interpretation layer.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve immutable evidence, diagnose forward, and do not promote keyboard.press.
